collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS - LIVING CULTURE VI: LAVASTONES AND THE SCHOOLS OF THOUGHT (LCF-01..50, draft, 2026-11-18)
Lavastones, the glowing orange-pink stones of Isola's lore, found on beaches and falling from the sky, and what they cost; and the island's schools of thought, Nature, Science, Spiritualism and Magic, arguing with and borrowing from each other.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. The owner waived the review ("I'm sure the draft events are fine"); every event passed the Isola rules and the final 15-point review, logged in the notes.

collection.description: A villager believes spirits guard the reef and wants offerings left there: leave them, or ask why.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) believes that spirits guard the reef and keep the fish coming, and wants the village to leave a small offering of fruit on the rocks each new moon. (friend) does not believe in spirits, but does not want to dismiss (subject) either. What should (friend) do?

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (friend) helps (subject) carry the fruit to the rocks each new moon. (friend.He/she) does not believe. (friend.He/she) finds it peaceful anyway. The fish keep coming. Whether because of the spirits, nobody can say, and (friend) stops wondering.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (friend) asks (subject) to explain. (subject) tells the old stories, and also a night when (subject.he/she) was lost at sea and felt something guide (subject.him/her) home. (friend) listens to all of it. (friend.He/she) still does not believe. (friend.He/she) understands.
